tools.name: list_services
tools.description: All nine Netik products (websites, systems, AI agents, automations, MCP servers, monthly care) with final prices in ILS (no VAT) and delivery times.

tools.name: get_price
tools.description: Price, delivery time, payment terms, what is included and the available add-ons (with their prices) for one product.

tools.name: create_quote
tools.description: Price a configuration (product, add-ons, care plan) exactly as the website does. Returns final totals in ILS (no VAT), what is paid today, delivery time and a link to the same configuration on the site.

tools.name: start_checkout
tools.description: Returns a link to the product page with the configuration filled in. A person must open it, enter their details and confirm; payment is always approved by a human.
